results.content: On her third studio album, Lost Weekend—which she teased fairly heavily at MSG, nesting seven new songs amongst the familiar ones—Bridgers is just as dropped in. Not only does she sing quite beautifully about love and grief and sometimes feeling a little outside her own body (the album highlights for me are “The Outside,” “Kill Me,” “Bobby,” and “As Before”), but she also does a fair amount of yowling and yelling and yipping about those things—ad-libs that let the feelings announce themselves [...] we know her for all while elevating her pop star skillset. The album’s earnest moments are touching, followed immediately by dance floor bangers that feel like a punch in the face (in a good way).
